from glom.core import glom

target = {
    'users': [
        {'name': 'Ada', 'scores': [3, 5]},
        {'name': 'Bob', 'scores': [2, 9]},
        {'name': 'Cy', 'scores': []},
    ]
}
spec = {
    'names': ('users', ['name']),
    'first_scores': ('users', [('scores', lambda scores: scores[0] if scores else None)]),
}
result = glom(target, spec)
result['paired'] = list(zip(result['names'], result['first_scores']))

print(result)
print([score for score in result['first_scores'] if score is not None])
print(result['paired'][-1])
